R6L-grouse-atv-0002.name: 300 m NE of Nass River
R6L-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R6L-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Hwy 37); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
5 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Hwy 37 right here: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from District of Stewart, about 71 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.0277, -129.14054, where the truck road ends (Hwy 37); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the 100 Road stretch, 5.1 km one way. About 102 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-30, Region 6. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 15 and more rows (synopsis page 51, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.
R6L-grouse-atv-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-30: about 1,657 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.24 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
